title: Robocon support arm: stock-thickness check
description: Illustrative teaching case. A 100 mm long, 20 mm wide arm is treated as a cantilever with a 10 N downward tip load. Select the lightest 3, 4 or 5 mm stock that limits tip deflection to 0.50 mm and keeps a yield safety factor of at least 2. The material properties are synthetic, not a real alloy.

materials.name: Synthetic aluminium-like teaching material 01
materials.provenance: Synthetic teaching fixture invented for METRON Milestone 1. Not a real alloy grade, not manufacturer data, and not for design use.
